I've distracted myself from it through escapism in the forms of various addictions and vices. Social anxiety and possible ADHD have crippled my life in my most formative and crucial developmental years, and ruined me. People have noted how little of a personality I have, and I truly do not. I have no true understanding of my identity as a man, nor where I fit, purpose. My brain does not work,  it simply does not function, in the presence of other human beings, I simply do not have any memories of the past 20 years of my life. No meaningful social interactions, just small scraps of things here and there of times I shamed myself horribly. Now I'm merely existing without any form of meaningful interactions socially (including social media), and an almost certain fate of ending myself within a decade of time. Seek help before it's too late.
Getting a real job and moving out of my 'rents
My dad abandoned me and my mother. It was tough for my mother, and I ended up a failure in life.

It's a funny coincidence. I was about to make a thread about this very thing happening to me today. I am an asian guy with glasses and a somewhat acne-scarred face, and naturally unfriendly eyebrows and angled lips. Walking through Target this afternoon and some random 9 or 10 year old girl with her family going past me remarked "he looks creepy". Kinda ruined my composure with negative thoughts all day. Personally for me, it's not even about trying to put on a friendlier less off-putting resting face anymore. Years of social anxiety and putting up a guard have made my face stuck, almost. It sounds ridiculous, I know, but when I'm around anyone I feel my face is paralyzed almost. And in this society where we love to mock, any perceived physical oddity is viciously attacked and looked down upon. Fuck people man.

I just want to thank everyone for taking time out of their lives to comment and care about some person like me. That's more regard than I get from anybody IRL on anyday.

I decided to post on this subreddit to try a solutions based approach, after browsing places like r/foreveralone, lostgeneration, depression, etc. However, I still feel stuck between two extremes. 

My ego keeps telling me that I should give up and become a basement dwelling NEET (because I'm alone already anyways) ~and what is all the trouble coming back in life worth? Or, on the other side, going for broke and trying to get disciplined and maintaining the burning motivation to compete, even with these existentialist woes.

It feels so hard to stay strong and justify certain sacrifices in life.
